character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Pixel art human NPC for a dark fantasy game: an abyss hunter, member of the expedition, a young adult man with short dark brown hair and tan skin, determined face. Light hunter gear: dark teal hooded jacket with the hood down, leather shoulder guard and chest straps, fingerless gloves, dark cargo trousers, sturdy boots, a small backpack with a rolled blanket, and a short energy spear with a glowing cyan blue tip held upright in his right hand. Standing ready. Same pixel style, same proportions and same size as the reference character.
